profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services
profile.summary:
Strives to achieve excellence in everything. Passionate about people and technology. Excels under pressure, finding excitement in a fast-paced environment. Has a variety of experience working as a team, under a supervisor, and as an individual.
Twenty years from now I see myself working as a Chief Information Security Officer.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Assess accuracy, completeness, and organization of company documents. Format Excel spreadsheet for easy viewing of the data. Bring notable issues and errors to supervisor. Work was presented to C-level management.

positions.title: Phone Operator/Customer Service
positions.description: Takes orders over the phone in English and limited Spanish. Uses time management and prioritization skills to flow between brewing coffee, bagging orders, taking phone calls, and speaking with the delivery drivers and kitchen. Excels in rapid-pace, detail-oriented environment that requires quick analysis of food based on the receipt and any additional instructions provided by the customer. Increases efficiency of the bagging process by marking when an item is missing or wrong on a ticket for fast identification of the problem.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
In the summer of 2018, I worked as part of a team of instructors under managers. I taught children ages 7-12 about basic programming, engineering, and game design. There were times when I needed to troubleshot hardware and software, and I came up with creative solutions to keep the program working in the meantime. I also assisted other instructors as needed and performed some administrative tasks during a week when a course was canceled.
In the summer of 2019, I will primarily be teaching children ages 10-12 about Java and how to build modifications to minecraft.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Microsoft Office · Python (Programming Language) · Debugging

positions.title: Secretary and Webmaster
positions.description: As the Webmaster, built and maintains website. Updates website with new stories written by club members. As the Secretary, sends blast emails containing updates, meeting reminders, and the current prompt. Schedules weekly meetings.

company.name: LU Creative Writing and Fiction Club

volunteerExperiences.description: I taught children in grades 3 - 7 basic typing, Microsoft, and coding skills under the supervision of a teacher. I spearheaded the school's participation in South Africa's Week of Coding, which lead to continuing to teach grades 4-7 coding skills after the week had passed. I had freedom to determine lesson plans and methods of teaching. I gained a new appreciation for services I previously took for granted and for people who grow up in bad neighborhoods. Many 7th-graders were involved in gangs, and it was hard watching how quickly these children had to grow up.

projects.title: The Light 90.9 Mobile App
projects.description: Developed Android and iOS mobile app for Liberty University's radio station, The Light 90.9. The app has live music and sports feed, information on programming and staff pulled from a database, and a contact form.

projects.title: Strategic Intelligence Society: Operation Cosmic Catalyst
projects.description: Conducted analysis on U.S. foreign policy, superpower influence in West Africa, and simulations from officers based on current events. Compiled and proposed a phishing campaign against the opposing team's leader through Google Doc's Script Editor using JavaScript and HTML. Ethical concerns lead us to bring the proposal to the club officers, who agreed the project should not be deployed.
